security_audit.summary: The static analyzer flagged many Markdown code fences as Ruby or shell backtick execution, but SKILL.md contains documentation templates and examples only. remediation.suggestion: No security change is required. Consider annotating examples more explicitly if marketplace scanners continue to misclassify fenced documentation.

remediation.issue: The skill uses Write as an allowed tool while its guidance is mainly process documentation.
remediation.suggestion: Keep Write only if the skill must create logs or templates. Otherwise remove it to reduce perceived capability scope.

content.value_statement: AI responses can repeat mistakes when feedback is not captured. This skill adds checkpoints, learning logs, and iteration cycles for measurable improvement.
actual_capabilities: Defines immediate, interactive, checkpoint, and pattern learning feedback loops.
Provides templates for baseline metrics, issue logs, learning logs, and quality gates.
Guides self-review before delivery using correctness, completeness, clarity, security, and efficiency checks.
Helps identify recurring response issues and convert them into prevention strategies.
Supports measurable improvement with before-and-after metrics and verification steps.
limitations: It does not store long-term memory unless the host tool provides persistence.
It does not run tests, inspect repositories, or verify code by itself.
It depends on honest feedback and accurate issue tracking from the assistant or user.
It can add process overhead when used for very small tasks.

use_cases.title: Improve Repeated Coding Tasks
use_cases.description: Create checkpoints and issue logs for coding work that often needs correction or review.

use_cases.title: Standardize Review Workflows
use_cases.description: Build a repeatable quality gate for teams that review AI-generated drafts or plans.

use_cases.title: Track Assistant Performance
use_cases.description: Measure recurring response issues and turn them into specific prevention rules.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Simple Feedback Loop
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a simple feedback loop for this task. Include one checklist, one review point, and one way to capture improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Add Checkpoints to a Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design checkpoints for this multi-step workflow. Show when to pause, what to review, and what must pass before continuing.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Recurring Issues
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these repeated issues and create a pattern learning loop. Include root causes, prevention steps, and metrics to track.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Measurable Improvement System
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced process design for ongoing use.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a full improvement system for AI response quality. Include baseline metrics, quality gates, learning logs, verification, and stop criteria.

output_examples.input: Create a feedback loop for AI-generated code reviews.
output: Checkpoint after each file review for correctness, missing risks, and clarity.
Issue log tracks missed bugs, unclear findings, and unsupported claims.
Verification compares later reviews against the same issue categories.

output_examples.input: Help reduce repeated over-explaining in assistant responses.
output: Pattern: responses include too much background before the answer.
Prevention: answer first, then add optional context only when useful.
Metric: count user requests for shorter responses across future sessions.

output_examples.input: Set up quality gates for a long planning task.
output: Gate one confirms all requirements are captured.
Gate two checks risks, dependencies, and assumptions.
Gate three verifies the final plan has clear owners and next actions.

best_practices: Use the lightest loop that still catches meaningful errors.
Track recurring issues with clear categories and concrete examples.
Verify improvements with metrics before changing the process again.
anti_patterns: Adding long review rituals to simple one-step tasks.
Recording vague feedback that cannot change future behavior.
Treating self-review as proof without user feedback or objective checks.

faq.question: Does this skill create persistent memory?
faq.answer: No. It provides templates and workflows. Persistence depends on the host environment and user-approved storage.

faq.question: Can it improve coding quality?
faq.answer: Yes. It can add review checkpoints, issue tracking, and prevention steps for repeated coding mistakes.

faq.question: Is this only for Claude?
faq.answer: No. The guidance can support Claude, Codex, Claude Code, and similar assistant workflows.

faq.question: When should I use it?
faq.answer: Use it for complex tasks, repeated workflows, recurring issues, or any work that needs measured improvement.

faq.question: What does it output?
faq.answer: It usually produces checklists, checkpoints, issue logs, learning logs, quality gates, and improvement metrics.

faq.question: Can it replace testing or human review?
faq.answer: No. It improves process discipline, but tests and human review remain necessary for important work.
